<documents>
<document id="docs-verification-letter">
AccountˆverificationˆletterˆAnˆaccountˆverificationˆletterˆconfirmsˆthatˆyouˆhaveˆanˆopenˆaccountˆwithˆus.ˆLandlords,ˆemployersˆandˆgovernmentˆofficesˆsometimesˆaskˆforˆone.ˆ##ˆGetˆaˆletterˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆDocuments,ˆthenˆAccountˆverificationˆletter.ˆTheˆPDFˆisˆreadyˆrightˆawayˆandˆshowsˆyourˆname,ˆaccountˆnumber,ˆaccountˆtypeˆandˆtheˆdateˆtheˆaccountˆwasˆopened.ˆ##ˆShowingˆyourˆbalanceˆYouˆcanˆchooseˆwhetherˆtheˆletterˆincludesˆyourˆcurrentˆbalance.ˆ##ˆCustomˆlettersˆWeˆcan'tˆwriteˆcustomˆletters,ˆsignˆforms,ˆorˆfillˆinˆthird-partyˆverificationˆforms.ˆTheˆstandardˆletterˆisˆacceptedˆbyˆmostˆorganizations.ˆ##ˆClosedˆaccountsˆLettersˆareˆonlyˆavailableˆforˆopenˆaccounts.ˆForˆaˆclosedˆaccount,ˆuseˆyourˆfinalˆstatement.ˆ##ˆSomeoneˆelseˆaskingˆWeˆdon'tˆconfirmˆaccountˆdetailsˆtoˆlandlords,ˆemployersˆorˆanyoneˆelseˆwhoˆcontactsˆusˆdirectly.ˆGiveˆthemˆtheˆletterˆyourself.ˆ##ˆIsˆitˆofficial?ˆYes.ˆTheˆletterˆcarriesˆaˆverificationˆcodeˆthatˆtheˆrecipientˆcanˆcheckˆonˆourˆhelpˆcenter.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="security-password-reset">
ResettingˆyourˆpasswordˆIfˆyouˆforgotˆyourˆpassword,ˆyouˆcanˆresetˆitˆfromˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen.ˆ##ˆResetˆyourˆpasswordˆ1.ˆTapˆForgotˆpasswordˆonˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen.ˆ2.ˆEnterˆtheˆemailˆonˆyourˆaccount.ˆWeˆsendˆaˆresetˆlink.ˆ3.ˆOpenˆtheˆlinkˆonˆtheˆsameˆphone,ˆconfirmˆtheˆone-timeˆcodeˆweˆtextˆyou,ˆandˆchooseˆaˆnewˆpassword.ˆTheˆlinkˆexpiresˆafterˆanˆhour.ˆIfˆitˆhasˆexpired,ˆstartˆagain.ˆ##ˆDidn'tˆgetˆtheˆemail?ˆCheckˆspamˆandˆmakeˆsureˆyouˆenteredˆtheˆemailˆyouˆsignedˆupˆwith.ˆIfˆyouˆnoˆlongerˆhaveˆaccessˆtoˆthatˆemail,ˆmessageˆsupportˆfromˆtheˆsign-inˆscreen.ˆForˆyourˆsecurity,ˆchangingˆtheˆemailˆonˆanˆaccountˆyouˆcan'tˆsignˆinˆtoˆneedsˆextraˆchecks.ˆ##ˆAfterˆaˆresetˆOtherˆdevicesˆareˆsignedˆout.ˆTheˆfirstˆtimeˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆBrookPayˆandˆexternalˆtransfersˆareˆlimitedˆtoˆ$500ˆforˆ24ˆhours.ˆIfˆyouˆdidn'tˆaskˆforˆaˆresetˆemail,ˆsomeoneˆmayˆhaveˆtypedˆyourˆemailˆbyˆmistake.ˆIfˆyouˆalsoˆseeˆaˆsign-inˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognize,ˆseeˆ"Ifˆsomeoneˆelseˆaccessedˆyourˆaccount".ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="fees-schedule-plus-v2">
PlusˆplanˆfeeˆscheduleˆHereˆisˆeveryˆfeeˆthatˆcanˆapplyˆtoˆaˆPlusˆaccount,ˆeffectiveˆMarchˆ1,ˆ2026.ˆFeesˆareˆtakenˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆwhenˆthey'reˆchargedˆandˆshowˆupˆinˆyourˆactivityˆfeedˆwithˆtheˆwordˆ"Fee".ˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆAmountˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆMonthlyˆfeeˆ|ˆ$5.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOut-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$2.50ˆ|ˆ|ˆInternationalˆATMˆwithdrawalˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆForeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆ|ˆ1%ˆ|ˆ|ˆCardˆreplacementˆ|ˆ$0.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆExpeditedˆcardˆshippingˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆdomesticˆwireˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆOutgoingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$35.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆIncomingˆinternationalˆwireˆ|ˆ$10.00ˆ|ˆ|ˆCashˆdepositˆatˆaˆretailˆstoreˆ|ˆ$3.00ˆ|ˆ##ˆDetailsˆYourˆfirstˆ3ˆout-of-networkˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆeachˆcalendarˆmonthˆareˆfree.ˆTheˆfeeˆappliesˆfromˆtheˆnextˆone.ˆNoˆplanˆhasˆoverdraftˆfees,ˆreturnedˆtransferˆfeesˆorˆinactivityˆfees.ˆTheˆmonthlyˆfeeˆisˆchargedˆonˆyourˆbillingˆdateˆandˆisn'tˆprorated.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
